root_cause.text: In `gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback()`, the local `netdev` variable is uninitialized when a short read occurs before `dev->netdev` is assigned, leading to a potential use of an undefined pointer when printing an error message; additionally, the error message incorrectly uses `urb->status` instead of the `rc` return value from `usb_submit_urb()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch initializes `netdev = NULL` (line 613) to avoid dereferencing an undefined value, and changes the error print from `ERR_PTR(urb->status)` to `ERR_PTR(rc)` (line 771). The commit message explicitly states: "In the case of a short read where netdev has not yet been assigned, initialize as NULL to avoid dereferencing an undefined value. Also report the error value of the failed resubmit."

intent_record.how: The error code printed when failing to resubmit an IN URB now comes from the local variable rc (the return value of the resubmit attempt) instead of urb->status (the URB's completion status).
